summary: Vanilla Cookbook is a self-hosted recipe management system that provides a clean user interface while handling complexity behind the scenes. It allows you to store, organise, and view your culinary instructions through a web browser. The project is distributed under the GPL-3.0 licence.
goodFor: It suits home users who want a straightforward, self-hosted web interface to manage personal recipe collections without unnecessary visual clutter.
watchOut: With a slowing maintenance trajectory and a modest community following, you may encounter unresolved bugs or lack rapid support for new feature requests.
deployNotes: As a Node.js application packaged for Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent storage volumes for your recipe data and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
